submitted.rationale: EQE is near zero across the Mg-Sb-O line at 2.4 eV. The response is concentrated at the Sb-rich end: 0.00011% at Sb 0.66, 0.00104% at 0.73, 0.00184% at 0.76 and 0.00096% at 0.81. The Mg-rich side is essentially zero (-0.00003% at 0.28), as expected for wide-gap MgO-rich phases. Index 27 (Sb 0.763) is the local maximum, with lower values on both sides.
